title: Material Design 3 elements not yet covered by a contract
coverage_note: Read-only audit of /home/user/BambuStudio at main 7d882d1e; nothing in the repository was modified. Method: a comment-stripping scanner over every GUI .cpp/.hpp/.h/.mm checked 25 legacy traits and found 3,853 hits. The traits were raw, hex, stock and system colours; ThemeColor aliases whose values are not kit values (Link #0078D4, Warning #FF6F00, BrandGreenHovered/Pressed, LightGreen, TextMuted/Grey700 #5c5f66, TextDisabled #9a9ba3); WXCOLOUR_GREY macros; constructed, system or hand-sized fonts; literal radii and unscaled pens; popups, menus, splitters and notebooks; scroll classes; about 40 stock control classes; system dialogs; and ImGui literal colours, COL_* constants and rounding literals. I then reviewed by hand: (a) all 309 GUI sources added since 2026-09-02 that still exist; (b) the 64 older GUI files with 300 or more changed lines since then (TextureImportDialog, Plater, AMSMaterialsSetting, Preferences, StatusPanel, MainFrame, GUI_App, ImGuiWrapper, GLCanvas3D, NotificationManager, AmsMappingPopup, SelectMachine, CreatePresetsDialog, UnsavedChangesDialog, ReleaseNote, SendMultiMachinePage, UpgradePanel, Widgets/*, etc.); (c) cross-cutting categories across the whole tree: all 34 popup classes and ad-hoc popups, tooltips (ParamTooltip, ButtonDisabledTip, RichTooltipPopup, MarkdownTip, ImGui tooltips), menus, splitters, notebooks (only wxSimplebook remains), scroll areas, ad-hoc wxDialog/DPIFrame chrome, kit widgets, and the ImGui layer (ImGuiWrapper base/combo/toolbar styles and icon tables, NotificationManager, every Gizmos/*.cpp, GLCanvas3D, BaseRenderer/LegacyRenderer, PartPlate, AssemblyStepsUtilsImgui); (d) web: hex, token, font and scrollbar counts for all 52 resources/web CSS files and inline HTML styles; a close read of filament_create, guide/23, model, model_new, login, device, flush, homepage3, fila_manager, resources/tooltip, the DeviceWeb device_page base styles and ams-control-web, the docs viewer CSS (DocsBrowserDialog::html_document), and the OfflineDocumentation reader plus scripts/documentation/build_bundle.py. Proof: all 54 proposed contracts run against current main in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/240ff335-90ea-545f-94e3-89325ef5c17b/scratchpad/w4audit/out/harness.test.mjs, which reuses the md3-conversion-contracts helpers (contracts.txt is beside it). Each one fails today with an AssertionError that names the element, with no syntax or runtime errors, so each pins something no current contract catches. Excluded because a wave3 check already fails on them: ProjectHistoryDialog wxChoice/wxTextCtrl; the ScheduledSettings/Panel, StatusHub and WorkflowPrintPanel labels; the LocalSecurity radios, lists and scrolled windows; the unscaled sizes in WorkflowPrintPanel and WorkspacePanel; the system message boxes in DocumentationBundle, SettingsDraftPanel and NativeLaunchAdapter; CameraHUD PopupMenu; the humidity popup; the command palette chrome; the 10th unclassified button palette (HelioHistoryDialog). Masked, not reported: the subtest 'stock wx controls are gone' stops at its wxChoice assertion, which hides wxCheckBox (IdentityHistoryPanel.cpp:41, SecurityPanels.cpp:137, ScheduledSettings/Panel.cpp:56,61,72), wxSpinCtrl (SecurityPanels.cpp:136,159, ScheduledSettings/Panel.cpp:57,73), wxSpinCtrlDouble (ScheduledSettings/Panel.cpp:127) and wxButton (Widgets/CameraHUD.cpp:535). That subtest will catch them once wxChoice is fixed. Treated as exempt data or recorded deviations: ink and AMS swatches, the CMYW bases, preset and default ink palettes, G-code and thermal gradients, tool and axis colours, QR modules, the kit-sanctioned rgba(0,0,0,.55) video scrims in CameraHUD, accent-seed choices, TabStrip group colours, emboss fonts, CJK fallback faces, Helio partner purple/blue, AMS_CONTROL_* in AMSItem/AMSControl, and the system file and folder dialogs (native-controls.md). Dead or unreachable, not reported: MonitorBasePanel (wxSplitterWindow with wxSP_3D), MediaFileFrame (native frame, {1600,900}), ProgressStatusBar (wxStatusBar), Plater::show_rich_tip (wxRichToolTip), SLAImportJob wxFilePickerCtrl, the commented-out G-code viewer menubar, the macOS-only menubar and tray menu, WindowsNativeVisualSmoke (CI env only), the developer-only WebViewDialog chrome. Dead legacy StateColor palettes are summarised only in the 'greens' item. Not covered: pre-existing files with fewer than 300 changed lines were reached only through the cross-cutting categories and the tree-wide ratchets (LinkLabel, warning orange, muted greys, button sizes, fonts, popups), not line by line. Examples are AMSItem/AMSControl paint (unscaled 2-4 px pens and radii 0-4 noted, under the recorded AMS deviation), Calibration*, Field.cpp, OG_CustomCtrl, PresetComboBoxes, ObjectDataViewModel and GLToolbar sprites. Raster icon usage outside the ImGui atlas and the AMS web assets was not re-audited (static bitmaps are already guarded by the triage CSV test). Helio partner web pages, vendor JS/CSS (jQuery, Shoelace, swiper, ckeditor), resources/web/data and the guide pages other than 23 got only the counted scans. No build, launch or screenshot was made; every finding comes from source. Conflicts and stale records found: tests/embedded_atlas_styles.test.mjs pins filament_create's --color-brand #00AE42 and the original web geometry, so it must be amended before the web pages can become pure MD3; the register row imgui-overlay-icon-glyphs says done but the legacy SVG markers remain; md3-design-system.md still claims native tokens equal the kit and that Button radius is height/2, and its retained-literal line numbers are stale. Line numbers were re-checked against 7d882d1e.
